confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu price levels, not checked against live listings or July 2026 data. Food and beer are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain and reflects July monsoon low season. Beer is bottled domestic lager pro-rated to 0.5 L because draught is less common. Cocktail and wine_glass were set at about 2x the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is South Asian budget-tourism pricing: local food and drink benchmarked to Nepal's cost base (NPR is pegged to the Indian rupee at 1.6 NPR per INR, roughly 140-145 NPR per USD assumed), and accommodation tiers reflect Thamel-area hostels and guesthouses in monsoon low season.
